title: Emotion Network Analysis During COVID-19 Quarantine - A Longitudinal Study
limitations: - Did not perform group classification based on gender or work status, presence of more people at home, history of mental health problems, and personality characteristics; - Generalizability of findings is limited due to high attrition when comparing baseline and longitudinal data; - The dimension structure of the POMS could have influenced the clustering in the networks.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration, code, or data availability. The authors state that the datasets are not readily available for public use and request to access them should be directed to ramonmail@gmail.com. The paper does not explicitly state whether the analysis was preregistered or not.
